author: Cptnwhizbang
body:
Apex is pretty fun. For D.Ursa, assuming you're raiding BoF, you basically just spam RS2 or Rend/Daggers depending on your buff situation. It still does help to get yours health low, but you are also able to  use Channelalus for T.All+++ so I don't really try to redline the same way RS does. 

I'm ~AL50 and my daggers top around 22mil during fast raids. I could *really* try to get it higher with berserks and more buffs. In more reasonable circumstances I'm hitting between 7 and 12mil with daggers and 4-9mil with RS2 again the current Beguiled Apollyon X raids.

author: StraightG0lden
body: Of the two I'd definitely go for Deity. The best RS build is probably ultimastrikes so you'd need to unlock deity anyway so you can try it out and always switch later. Eventually you'll want most of the celestial classes for different things, such as Gilga for chained shield etc

author: dreambig5
body:
Deity doesn't make sense as a new T10 since you'll have to wait to unlock Ultima & ultimastrikes (lvl 245). So getting the celestial class for it, once again....I don't think would be the right move here.

based on what you like playing, and given that you're looking for advice between these two, I'd suggest going RS. 

I'd personally rack up a ton more towershards. (speaking as a T11 w/ all the pets, 2 of all the celestial weapons, all celestial classes & also someone that made the mistake of getting my alt to T10 too soon). It's SOOO Much easier to run through towers as T9, I wish I didn't rush it.

Btw, I'm confused what you mean about (minus augments). Have you not been beating the raid on the last floor of the towers?

\---

TLDR:

D. Ursa only after hitting lvl 245. Start w/ realmy & get a feel for it before buying the specialization class, and a weapon.
